subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: Should OpenClaw expose a typed reset-greeting policy/model override for bare `/new` and `/reset`, and which default should it use across chat and Gateway reset surfaces?
rationale: The remaining work changes compatibility-sensitive reset behavior and provider/model routing, so automation should not choose whether default resets spend a model turn, stay acknowledgement-only, or expose both modes.

options.title: Define one reset-start policy
options.body: Create a single typed policy covering ack-only, startup-turn, prompt customization, and optional model override, then update schema/docs/tests together.

options.title: Keep ack-only default, add opt-in startup turn
options.body: Preserve the shipped cheap reset behavior and expose an explicit maintainer-approved mode for persona workflows that need a model greeting.

options.title: Defer new config
options.body: Keep current static acknowledgements and leave prompt/startup-turn customization to the existing related discussions until maintainers are ready to sponsor the contract.

recommendation.title: Define one reset-start policy
recommendation.body: Create a single typed policy covering ack-only, startup-turn, prompt customization, and optional model override, then update schema/docs/tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans the shipped acknowledgement branch, config compatibility, and reset contract review history that steipete most directly touched.
